_comment: First early-validation preview of the v0.10.0 capability wave after public v0.9.1; this declaration authorizes exactly 0.10.0-preview.1.

The inspected candidate starts at v0.9.1 commit 5a55bab4aaed9437f3c51797c1e794c87b5f3779 and contains current main through PR #1054 plus PR #1057. The actual published candidate is the exact merge commit of the reviewed PR that carries this declaration.
Required scope is the reviewed semantic annotation contract (#566), the layered/DDD annotation source family (#569), and PR #1057's correction of repository source metrics and Structure badge depth.

PR #1054 contributes the shared canonical-classifier seam, but #568 remains open for final package/catalog parity and full integration acceptance; this preview does not claim that task or the v0.10.0 capability wave complete.

The source-only annotation package and remaining role families, context composition, adoption guidance, and annotation-specific packed-consumer gate remain explicitly outside this preview. The four existing release packages do not yet distribute the full annotation source set.

Release-publisher fixes under #1042 were merged after the v0.9.1 tag to complete that previous publication and are present as delivered release-process context, not as v0.10 product capability. Dependency updates from PRs #1048 and #1051 are categorized separately in generated release notes.

The release-note delta is based on merged PRs #1045-#1048, #1050, #1051, #1053-#1055, and #1057; release-pipeline-only and test-only PRs are excluded from public notes by their existing ignore-for-release label.

Because v0.9.1 is the latest stable tag, the maintainer handoff must use release_type=preview and version_override=0.10.0-preview.1; automatic calculation would select 0.9.2-preview.1. This declaration authorizes no stable 0.10.0 or other preview number.

required_items.summary: Define canonical annotation identities, source-only packaging boundaries, role semantics, metadata composition, and version compatibility
Add the reviewed layered/clean and DDD semantic annotation source definitions
Count source files and lines across ambiguous project ownership and include dependency depth in the Structure badge

excluded_items.reason: The complete source-only ArchLinterNet.Annotations package distribution and integration of all approved role families remain open; this preview does not claim the finished package adoption experience.
The candidate contains the already-merged shared classifier seam from PR #1054, but the issue remains open for package/catalog parity and full integration acceptance.
CQRS, messaging, and web/API annotation families are separate open v0.10 work and are not required for this early preview.
Infrastructure, UI, and Unity annotation families are separate open v0.10 work and are not required for this early preview.
The complete bounded context metadata composition model remains open; this preview does not claim its final semantics.
The full annotation-first adoption, migration, compatibility, and AI-authoring guidance remains open and is not claimed by this preview.
Annotation-specific packed external-consumer acceptance remains open; the preview uses only the existing release package set and does not claim final v0.10.0 consumer acceptance.

delivered_items.reason: The v0.9.1 immutable-release correction was completed after its tag; publisher fixes now present in this candidate are prior-release process context, not v0.10 product scope.
